1
Sada Shabir Denda Si Rida Teri Rida Zainab.
Jidda Si Maan Oh Ghazi Salamat Nayi Riya Zainab.
Kiwein Pyasi Sakina Nu Sunawaan Haal Maqtal Da.
Lahu V Naal Pani De Zameen Te Beh Gaya Zainab.

2
Kitay Bazu Kitay Zanu Kitay Abbas Si Ran Wich.
Mainu Lasha Taein Khud Le Gaya Ghazi Mera Zainab.
Main Mohsin Veer De Wangoon Odhi Peshani Chumda Saan.
Mainu Abbas Ne Jis Dam Bulaya Si Bhira Zainab.

3
Qasam Ghazi Ne Apni De Ke Mainu Rook Chadiya Si.
Main Tainu De Nayi Sakiya Madad De Layi Sada Zainab.
Khulay Sir Wekhdi Jandi Si Akbar Sir Nu Ghazi De.
Gayi Jad Sham De Pasay Nibha Ke Karbala Zainab.

from pathlib import Path
p = Path(\"src/data/lyrics/sada-shabir-denda-si-rida-teri-rida-zainab-lyrics-punjabi-2025-latest-tajpoint-468e0afa21d3cf60fa09.md\")
_, meta, body = p.read_text().split('---')
roman = meta.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n')[1]
for edition, numbers in [(roman, '123'), (body, '۱۲۳')]:
    blocks = edition.strip().split('\\n\\n')
    assert len(blocks) == 3
    for block, number in zip(blocks, numbers):
        lines = [line.strip() for line in block.splitlines()]
        assert lines[0] == number and len(lines) == 5
        assert all(line and not line.endswith('.') for line in lines)
assert '\\u200c' not in body
print('Verified three matching four-verse stanza blocks.')
PY"

item.text:
Reconstructed all 12 verses in Shahmukhi Punjabi and preserved the Roman wording in `romanLyrics`. Verified that both editions have three matching four-verse stanzas. Updated the titles and script metadata and removed the resolved `noUrdu` tag.

I read the two uses of `Sada` as ساڈا (“our”) in the opening and صدا (“call”) in stanza 3.
